name: kinetic-ui-monorepo
description: Kinetic UI — motion-first React components. npm packages + copy-paste registry from one source.

scripts.build:packages: node scripts/gen-index.mjs && npm run build -w @kineticui/core -w @kineticui/icons -w @kineticui/motion -w @kineticui/ui -w @kineticui/blocks -w @kineticui/cli && node scripts/gen-theme-css.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run registry && npm run build -w docs
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run registry && npm run dev -w docs
scripts.release: npm run build:packages && npm publish -w @kineticui/core -w @kineticui/icons -w @kineticui/motion -w @kineticui/ui -w @kineticui/blocks -w @kineticui/cli --access public
